title: Generative AI and ML-based MBD for automotive state estimators: code, results and pre-registrations
description: Code, per-seed results and pre-registration records of the evaluation of a generative-AI and machine-learning model-based design pipeline for automotive state estimators on public data: vehicle fuel flow (two cars), battery-cell state of charge and a field battery energy storage system (state of charge and cell temperature). Includes the data-reduction protocol, generators (DDPM, TimeGAN, recurrent VAE, VAR, block bootstrap), physical audits, physics-structured and hybrid models, the utility gate, and the context-gating test of refuel detection.
